title: Figure 13: provisional breakthrough-era cockpit with spherical virtual surround display
description: Digital composite rendering of a wireframe pilot seat and grey flat display panels inside a translucent sphere showing Earth from orbit with grid overlays and coloured display zones. Captioned "Figure 13. Provisional Breakthrough-Era Cockpit. The spherical zone around the cockpit center represents the virtual surround display onto which images of the environment outside the vehicle are displayed," with physical displays in the "tunnel vision" zone. Credited to A. Szames with background image through M. Cherfi.
